name: Stamp
scaffolding_intent: Entity lifts to reveal its silhouette then snaps back with cracks radiating on impact, marking exactly where it stands

parameters.name: liftPixels
parameters.description: How many pixels the entity lifts up

parameters.name: crackCount
parameters.description: Number of crack lines on impact

correction_intent: Child placed an entity somewhere it is not ('on the bridge' when it stands by the river; 'floating' when it is on the ground; 'inside' when it is outside). Target that entity. Not for something hidden behind another entity; that is S1.
suggestion_intent: Child mentioned an entity without saying where it is, although its position is distinctive (on a bridge, under a tree, in a doorway, at the edge of a cliff). Target that entity. Requires a location that adds to the story.
